long_description:
NYC's Biggest Halloween Day party. The Chai Rave takes over EDEN Times Square with IndoHouse, BollyTech & pure main character energy.

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events1/banners/f2d53af0-c93b-11f1-849d-d196120da468-rimg-w696-h740-dc080808-gmir.jpg 

Manhattan’s fine assets, demons, and everyone carrying the vibes: you are officially summoned. 🧛‍♂️✨ 
The Chai Rave is taking over EDEN Times Square for our biggest, most unhinged Halloween day-to-night party yet. We’re turning the venue into a 2-floor sanctuary of pure main character energy, demonic behavior, and sinful masquerade.
The vision is simple: throw on your absolute best fit, lose your mind on the dance floor, and match our energy before the night ends.

🔊 THE TRACKLIST (2 Floors of Pure Heat)
We’re going back-to-back across two levels with:
IndoHouse & BollyTech (The edits are lethal)Afrobeats & Hip-Hop+ Secret guest DJs & surprises we can’t even drop yet 💥🗓️ THE LOGISTICS
WHEN: Saturday, October 31st | 3:00 PM - 10:00 PM (Get there early, lines will be long)WHERE: EDEN (20 West 36th St, NYC)ENTRY: 21+ only (Bring a real physical ID, security is not playing)
🎭 THE FIT CHECK
Sinful, divine, or masked. Go all out. If you don't bring your best costume, don't look for yourself on the recaps. See you in the inner sanctum. 🔥
